author: TeIq
content:
Architect verdict: APPROVE-WITH-FOLLOW-UPS.

Independent verification: build/clippy/fmt/SQLX_OFFLINE/wasm/xtask all clean. 11 reversal unit tests pass. Forbidden-pattern grep clean: zero UPDATE on actions in any src, zero unwrap/expect in non-test reversal code.

Append-only invariant preserved: every reversal is a new Action row with kind=Reverse + reverses_action_id; the original action is never UPDATEd. Authorization is a pure function with full unit coverage — testable in isolation.

Hooks for label neg=true emission are flagged in source for #28 to consume when M4 label emission lands; no premature signing wiring.

Follow-up filed: #55 — pre-existing bad_request_carries_static_message test failure in api/error.rs (not from #36; surfaced during dispatch).
